what: A Jupiter-8 style synthesizer for the M-VAVE FM-1 (both hardware versions). Eight voices in two parts (Whole, Dual, Split or 2-Part), two VCOs per voice with sync and cross mod, HPF and 12/24 dB ladder VCF, two ADSRs, LFO, arpeggiator and polyphonic portamento, 64 patches. Chorus and 17 MFX types, delay and reverb. A piano-roll sequencer with a pattern per part, song mode, swing and MIDI out. USB audio, USB and TRS MIDI.
author: Stephane Schmitz
